alyssa: quick async standup
alyssa: what I did — tuned kernel prefetch thresholds (lowered hot-slot eviction thresh), landed kv-evict fix in canary (PR #4821). ran microbench against seq len 512 and 1024, looked good.
alyssa: blocker — seeing a p95 bump (~60ms) for 2k token sequences after warmup on canary nodes, not consistent across shards. need a focused sweep + traces.
alyssa: today — run perf sweep across canary pool, collect jaeger traces + flamegraphs, triage if it's kernel slot steal or slow KV warmup. pinging infra for additional canary capacity.

devon: could you paste the PR link + the perf query you used?
alyssa: sure — PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4821
alyssa: perf query I ran:
```
# prometheus p95 tokens query
rate(latency_seconds_bucket{handler="generate"}[5m])
# rough script to repro locally
python tools/repro.py --model gptx-small --length 2048 --concurrency 4
```

ron: fwiw slot-steal looked noisy yesterday, maybe related. can you include the slot/queueing counters from /metrics?
alyssa: yes adding that to the sweep. grabbing `runtime_slot_steal_total` + `kv_warmup_hits` in the trace.

maria: did the canary use the new batching config or old? batching changes can amplify p95 for long sequences.
alyssa: canary used new adaptive-batcher (config: max_batch_tokens=4096, slot_timeout_ms=5). I rolled it back on one shard and p95 dropped ~15ms.
jake: I can repro on my dev alloc, will run the `repro.py` and attach logs here when done.

infra-bot: canary-rollout: shard-7 -> deploy succeeded @ 6112233490 :rocket:

jake: repro started — giving it ~30m then posting results.

devon: small nit — PR #4821 needs a unit test for the eviction heuristic change, left a comment.
alyssa: ack, adding test during sweep.

ron: if it's batch config + slot steal we should try reducing `max_batch_tokens` to 3072 on a canary and compare. low-risk experiment.
maria: also check KV cache TTL for long contexts, maybe we aren't priming all segments. `kv_cache_miss_total` will tell.

alyssa: thanks everyone, will run sweep, post a short summary + traces here. will tag @eng-sre if it looks infra-y. :thumbsup:
